Goals: ant. alignment only - do not move the LR67

Upper arch 
Stage 1 - perform all movements together 
1. Compress U7s 1-2mm
2. Expand U6543 RHS and LHS
3. Do not allow movement of the upper labial segment in stage 1
Stage 2 - movement only after stage 1
1. Align upper 2-2 with proclination, IPR and round tripping 

Lower arch 
Stage 1 - perform all movement together 
1. Compress LL7 1-2mm do not move LR67
2. Expand LR345 LL345
3. Procline L2-2 
Stage 2 - movements only after stage 1
1. Hinge rotation correction of the LR3 LL3
